message: Nursing Home Inspection & Deficiency Tracker is complete and ready for review. 730,114 records from 6 CMS datasets covering 14,710 facilities across 53 states. 506 PE-owned and 184 REIT-owned facilities identified. $480M in tracked fines. Average quality score 0.918 (99.8% above threshold). 16 outreach targets identified across research, media, client, and employer categories. Dashboard, exports (CSV/JSON/Excel/Markdown), and methodology doc all ready. See projects/nursing-home-tracker/ for full deliverables.

State PUC Rate Case Tracker is complete and ready for review. 621 rate cases (582 real from OR PUC EDOCKETS + 39 from PA/CA/IN/WA) covering 467 utilities across 5 states. Date range 1990-2024. $23B total revenue requested, $10.5B approved. Average quality score 0.670 (100% above threshold). 186 tests passing, 7 problems resolved. 17 outreach targets identified across research, media, client, and employer categories. Dashboard, exports (CSV/JSON/Excel/Markdown), methodology doc, and pitch materials all ready. See projects/puc-rate-tracker/ for full deliverables.

EPA TRI Community Health & Demographics Tracker is complete and ready for review. 22,936 facilities from all 50 US states. 155,814 chemical release records (571 chemicals, 44,019 carcinogen releases). 6.54 billion lbs total reported releases. Cross-linked with 3,143 county health and 3,143 county demographics records. 100% FIPS county code resolution. 4,480 parent companies, 30 industry sectors. Average quality score 0.847, 100% above threshold. 169 tests passing, 8 problems resolved. 20+ outreach targets identified across research, media, nonprofit, and consulting categories. Dashboard (7 sections), exports (CSV/JSON/Excel/Markdown), methodology doc, and outreach package all ready. See projects/epa-tri-tracker/ for full deliverables.

CFPB Consumer Complaint Cross-Linked Analysis is complete and ready for review. 13,689,875 CFPB complaints cross-linked with 27,832 FDIC institutions and 386 enforcement actions. 933,041 cross-links via 3-stage entity resolution (exact/normalized/fuzzy), avg confidence 0.956. 284 companies matched to FDIC institutions. Quality avg 0.487, 100% above 0.40 threshold. 107 tests passing, 9 problems resolved. 1,521-line Streamlit dashboard with 7 sections. Exports (CSV/JSON/Excel/Markdown), methodology doc, outreach package (20 targets, 5 email templates, pitch materials) all complete. P5 (FFIEC CRA access) remains OPEN but non-critical. See projects/cfpb-complaint-tracker/ for full deliverables.

Research cycle complete: 7 new ideas evaluated across transportation safety, labor/employment, housing, trade/commerce, and telecom domains. 5 ideas scored 22+ and accepted/proposed: (1) NHTSA Vehicle Safety Defect Tracker (25/30) — all 5 APIs tested and working, 2M+ records; (2) Employer Labor Compliance Tracker (24/30) — cross-links WHD+NLRB+OSHA, Project Firewall timing; (3) HUD Affordable Housing Compliance Tracker (24/30) — 54K LIHTC projects cross-linked with inspection scores; (4) H-1B Employer Compliance Tracker (23/30) — Project Firewall makes this urgent; (5) PHMSA Pipeline Safety (22/30) and CPSC Product Recall (22/30) as backup. FCC Broadband rejected (19/30). RECOMMENDED BUILD ORDER: NHTSA Vehicle Safety first (highest score, all APIs verified, massive scale), then Employer Labor Compliance (urgent buyer need from Project Firewall). See state/research_briefs/ for full briefs on all 7 ideas.

SEC Corporate Subsidiary & Ownership Mapping is complete and ready for review. 18,865 unique subsidiaries from 672 parent companies across 1,467 filings (2023-2025). 1,938 tax haven entities across 111 jurisdictions. Multi-strategy HTML parser with 76% parse success rate. Quality avg 0.806, 100% above threshold. 90 tests passing. Top companies: Comcast (1,530 subs), Lennar (1,122), Marriott (827). Delaware is #1 jurisdiction (6,426 subs). Cayman Islands (239), Ireland (204), Netherlands (500) among top tax havens. Exports (CSV/JSON/Excel/Markdown), methodology doc, outreach package (17 targets, 3 email templates), and 8-section dashboard all complete. See projects/sec-subsidiary-mapping/ for full deliverables.

NHTSA Vehicle Safety Defect Tracker is complete and ready for review. 500,000 complaints, 2,955 recall campaigns (all 33 major makes), 5,326 defect investigations. 175,443 cross-links tracing the full complaint → investigation → recall lifecycle. 26,615 crashes, 2,064 deaths, 7,337 fires tracked. 6,576 unique vehicle make/model pairs. 88 tests passing, 6 problems resolved. 8-section interactive dashboard, exports (CSV/JSON/Excel/Markdown), methodology doc, outreach package (15+ targets, 3 email templates) all complete. See projects/nhtsa-vehicle-safety/ for full deliverables.

DOL WHD and OSHA data confirmed available on v4 API. WHD Enforcement (Dataset ID 10246, 110 columns, FY 2005+) and OSHA Inspection (Dataset ID 10313, 36 columns, daily updates) both accessible at apiprod.dol.gov/v4. ACTION NEEDED: Register for free API key at dataportal.dol.gov/registration. API pattern: apiprod.dol.gov/v4/get/WHD/enforcement/json?X-API-KEY=<KEY>&limit=500&offset=0. This is the only viable path — all legacy bulk CSV URLs are permanently dead.

Employer Labor Compliance Tracker is complete (Phase 1) and ready for review. 233,011 NLRB cases across 91,656 employer profiles, all 50 states + DC, 2015-present. Average quality 0.981. Top repeat offenders: USPS (24K), UPS (2.6K), Starbucks (2.2K), AT&T (958), Amazon (395). 107 tests passing. 8-section dashboard, exports (CSV/JSON/Excel/Markdown), methodology doc, outreach package (20 targets across law firms/ESG/media/research, 3 email templates, pitch materials) all complete. P1 (DOL WHD/OSHA data) remains OPEN for Phase 2 — confirmed available on DOL v4 API, needs free API key registration. See projects/employer-labor-compliance/ for full deliverables.

See projects/hud-housing-tracker/ for full deliverables.
